name: RVGL
description:
RVGL is a cross-platform, enhanced rewrite of the classic 1999 radio-controlled car racing game Re-Volt. Built with modern OpenGL and SDL2, it brings the miniature racing classic natively to modern Linux desktops.

Features:
- Native 64-bit Linux port with high-resolution widescreen and 4K support
- Online multiplayer racing with peer-to-peer networking and online lobby browser
- Uncapped framerates, enhanced particle effects, and dynamic lighting
- Full support for community cars, custom tracks, and legacy Re-Volt mods
- Modern gamepad support with analog steering, force feedback, and split-screen mode
